en: "Go on, go on! All... by... your... self!"{w}
note: [JP] is spelled out syllable by syllable for teasing emphasis; rendered as spaced-out words.

en: "H-hey, wait! Stop pushing me!"{w}

"Come now, young master, show your dear Gurtia
how brave you are!"{w}

(And then he'll get stomped on and beaten black and blue,
and come crying to me for help, sobbing his eyes out!{w}Ahh, I can't wait... Hee hee hee hee!!){w}
note: Parentheses = Gurtia's inner thought, kept. Gurtia's laugh [JP] rendered "Hee hee hee" throughout the slice (142, 239, 285).

en: Elpina
"Yikes, Sis! Your eyes look sooo dangerous~!"{w}
note: Elpina calls Gurtia [JP]: "Sis".

en:
"But I'm the leader...
Somehow... doesn't this seem kinda unfair???"{w}

"Whatever do you mean, young master?{w}Everyone is doing this precisely because
they want you to grow."{w}
"Really?"{w}

"Of course.{w}Besides, you look wonderful when you're
trying your best!"{w}
"R-really? ...Hehe!"{w}
"Nice one, Sis.{w}You actually got Mirco of all people fired up!"{w}
note: [JP] = "Mirco, of all people".

en:
"Okay, I'll go beat them!
Gurtia, watch me!!"{w}

"Yes! I'll be watching closely!
Off you go, now!"{w}
"Go get 'em, Mirco!"{w}

"If this is your first battle,
allow me, Zephal, to offer you some advice."{w}{p}"Young master, you lack speed, strength, wits,
skill and guts. You must devise tactics that
cover for those shortcomings."{w}
note: Insult kept at full force: Zephal lists five things Mirco lacks.

en:
"Cover...?
Um... so what ARE my strong points?"{w}
"If you have any, I'd like to know myself!"{w}

"Young master!
Your strong point is being cute!"{w}

"Uh-huh.{w}Like how happy-go-lucky you are -- you're
such fun to mess with!"{w}
"Aw, shucks... You're making me blush!"{w}
Zapper
"Youuu little-- Quit playing dumb!{w}If you come back a loser, you'll answer to me!!"{w}
note: [JP] rendered "you'll answer to me".

en:
"I won't lose!{w}I've got the demon sword Baltagias
that my uncle gave me!"{w}
note: The sword name is written in hiragana ([JP]), set off by spaces, a childish proud emphasis; glossary spelling Baltagias kept, no special casing.
Hess addresses the absent [JP] (later revealed as the uncle Dalisiamarte, slice 002): "Master".

en:
"Here I come!
I'm gonna beat you to a pulp!!"{w}
"Gyaaah!"{w}
You routed Mirco.{w}
"Oh my, young master~ You look positively battered!"{w}
note: [JP]: painful to look at; Gurtia is gloating.

en: "What kind of stance was that?!{w}Didn't I teach you that's not how you hold a sword?!"{w}{p}"And you don't commit when you step in!{w}Your hips should be more like this! Like THIS!!"{w}
"Well, Mirco, you're an idiot, after all."{w}
note: Accuracy: [JP] is vocative (Elpina answers Mirco's line 191 to his face; he retorts in 195), so addressed to Mirco, not about him.

en: "I'm not an idiot!"{w}
"Everyone, you're going too far.{w}Please don't pick on the young master so much."{w}
"Gurtia~!"{w}
note: ♪ (happy tone) rendered as "~!" since the output is ASCII only.
[JP] = his head (brains) is pitiful; the "defence" is a worse insult, kept at full strength.

en: "What are you saying?!"{w}

"Oh, that's right!
Sorry, Mirco, you half-baked little greenhorn."{w}
note: [JP] = half-boiled and unripe: "half-baked little greenhorn".

en: "Don't apologize!"{w}

note: [JP] from Zephal = "Master Mirco".

en: "Heyyy!!!{w}I tried my best too, you know?!"{w}
"Yes. What a splendid defeat it was!"{w}

"Mean. You're all so mean...{w}Hess...
Am I really that hopeless?"{w}

"Eh?! Well, that's... um...{w}R-right, the young master is, er, one of those...
a late bloomer, wouldn't you say?!"{w}
note: [JP] seeks agreement from the others; "wouldn't you say" so that Mirco's retort in 219 lands.

en: "'Wouldn't you say'? Who are you asking to agree?"{w}

note: Source ends without punctuation (trails on [JP]); kept without a final period. [JP] = "lord" (also the Lord class).

en: "I just got called 'like this'!"{w}
note: Hess's gender is unknown in the glossary, so the retort avoids "he/she said".

en: "For now, young master...{w}let's cure your bed-wetting. Everything starts there."{w}

"Aaaaaaahhhhh!
Don't tell theeeem!!"{w}
note: [JP] = "you mustn't say it"; "Don't tell them" fits the scene (the party and the others are listening).

en:
"What, bed-wetting?!{w}Young master, don't tell me you still wet the bed?!
You did?! Surely not, at your age?!"{w}
"You promised... you wouldn't tell..."{w}
"Oh, I'm so sorry. It just slipped out!"{w}
"Th-this old servant is mortified..."{w}
note: [JP] (old retainer's self-reference) rendered "this old servant", gender-neutral.

en:
"It stiiinks!
I can smell it all the way over here!!"{w}

"The young master washing his own soiled things
was so miserable and so lovely~! Hee hee hee!!"{w}
note: Accuracy: restored the main verb and past tense ([JP]); the draft was a verbless fragment.

en: "Uuuuuugh..."{w}
"Y-you...{w}You pants-wetting little bastard!!"{w}
note: [JP]: [JP] is coarse; "pants-wetting little brat" keeps the insult. Could go harsher ("bastard") if the lead prefers. | Accuracy: [JP] is a coarse insult (bastard/punk); "brat" softened it. Raised to "bastard" to match the force that makes Hess protest (247) and Zephal apologise (249). Lead may pick "punk" if this reads too strong.

en: "Yowch?!"{w}
note: [JP]: yelp at being hit.

en: "H-here now! Zephal!"{w}

"Pardon me. I apologize for hitting you.
But still, how pathetic..."{w}
"Surely it was just a fluke.{w}The young master is no child, after all."{w}
"Actually, this morning made three days in a row!"{w}
"Whaaaaaat?!"{w}
"H-hey, wait, Gurti"{w}
note: Cut off mid-name ([JP]); kept unfinished with no dash, as in the source.

en: "Th-that does it! I am the Hell Master!!"{w}
note: Glossary catchphrase "I am the Hell Master!".

en: "Fwooooooaaaaargh!!"{w}
"Eek, eeeeek?! Zephal's gotten ma..."{w}
note: Cut off mid-word ([JP]……); kept unfinished.

en:
"Not content with once or twice...
THREE TIMES?!!"{w}
"Hwaaagh?!"{w}
"Pardon me. I apologize for hitting you."{w}
note: Same wording as the first sentence of 249, as in the source.

en: "Y-yoo... yoo're nod sowwy ad all, are yoo"{w}
note: Mirco speaks through a swollen face: [JP] = "You have no intention of apologizing, do you". Rendered as mangled but readable English.

en: "Sigh... There's a limit to how pathetic one can be!{w}At this rate, how can I ever face the master..."{w}
"Now then, young master, let's treat your wounds.{w}Here's some salve. Hold still for me~"{w}
"Ow! Ow, it stings, Gurtia!!"{w}
"It's medicine, after all. It can't be helped.{w}See, it hurts. There! And therrre~!"{w}
note: Gurtia presses the salve on deliberately (see 283).

en: "Ow, I said it hurts! You're doing this on purpose, aren't you?!"{w}
"Hee hee hee hee!!"{w}

"W-well, I'll let you off with this for today!
Next time, I'll beat you for sure!"{w}
Let him go?
note: Choice prompt after Mirco's defeat; Mirco is male per glossary.

en:
"Urk..."{w}{p}"I-if you bully me,
my uncle won't stand for it!{w}My uncle is a Demon Duke, you know!"{w}
note: Glossary: [JP] = Demon Duke.
